verdict.rationale: LlamaParse provides building blocks for background automation: asynchronous jobs with webhook notifications on completion or failure, an n8n node for no-code document workflows, composable APIs that can be chained (Split, then Extract), and batch processing. However, the evidence shows no native scheduler, trigger, or always-on automation feature, so autonomous background runs depend on external orchestration such as n8n or your own code. Missing for 10: native scheduled or event-triggered automations (e.g., watch folders or connectors), built-in workflow orchestration, and hands-on corroboration of autonomous background operation.
